h1: Custom Unisex Lotion for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Shop custom unisex lotion for your team or event. Perfect for any gender. Bulk orders available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom unisex lotion is a versatile promotional product that appeals to everyone, regardless of gender. Unlike gender-specific lotions, these formulations focus on universal skin care benefits like moisturizing and soothing. Ideal for corporate gifts, safety kits, or event giveaways, they offer a practical and inclusive branding opportunity. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or labels to create a thoughtful, everyday essential that recipients will actually use.
heroAltText: Custom unisex lotion bottles with brand logo, suitable for all genders, in bulk packaging.
